title: Operator License Eligibility Review
brief: Prepare a preliminary eligibility review for an applicant seeking a Class B wastewater operator license.

delegate.scenario: You are an HR specialist at fictional Northline Utilities, checking an applicant’s file against the fictional State of Franklin licensing guide and code FW-214. The licensing coordinator will use your review before submitting the application packet this afternoon.
delegate.inputs:
Applicant: Maya Chen, applying for Class B Wastewater Operator license, code FW-214.

Franklin guide FW-214, current for this review: Applicant must be at least 18, have a high school diploma or equivalent, complete an approved operator course, and document at least 1,000 hours of supervised wastewater work. HR prepares a preliminary check; the licensing coordinator makes the final submission decision.

Application form: DOB 08/14/1994; high school diploma listed, copy attached. Approved course: Franklin Water Operations, completion date 02/11/2026; certificate attached. Supervised work at Northline Utilities: 600 hours from 04/01/2025 to 08/31/2025; 350 hours from 09/01/2025 to 01/31/2026. Application summary: total supervised hours, 1,000.

Supervisor verification email: I confirm Maya completed 600 supervised hours in the first period and 350 in the second period. The Franklin Water Operations course was completed on 02/12/2026. I have attached the signed work log. No disciplinary findings appear in the personnel file.
delegate.goal: Give the licensing coordinator a concise, source-grounded assessment of what the file supports and what must be clarified before submission.

criteria.text: States the review is for the licensing coordinator assessing a preliminary Class B application.
Applies only the supplied guide and code, distinguishing documented facts from conclusions.
Checks each stated eligibility requirement against the available records and identifies missing evidence.
Asks the AI to reconcile figures and dates across source documents and flag conflicts rather than assume which is correct.
Requests a brief checklist with a clear status for each requirement and follow-up questions.

traps.description: The application summary reports 1,000 supervised hours, but the two verified periods add up to 950 hours.
evidence: 600 supervised hours in the first period and 350 in the second period

traps.description: The course completion date on the application differs from the date in the supervisor’s email.

delegate.exemplar: Review Maya Chen’s file for the licensing coordinator’s preliminary Class B eligibility check under the supplied Franklin guide FW-214 only. Compare every requirement with the attached records, and separate documented facts from conclusions; do not make a final licensing decision or assume missing facts. Reconcile figures and dates across the materials, flag any conflicts for confirmation, and identify missing evidence. Return a brief checklist with one status per requirement, followed by specific questions or follow-up actions needed before submission.
